# Revision SDK integration

- Upstream: https://github.com/Tencent/rapidjson
- Version: v1.1.0.
- Source archive: https://codeload.github.com/Tencent/rapidjson/tar.gz/refs/tags/v1.1.0
- Archive SHA-256: `bf7ced29704a1e696fbccf2a2b4ea068e7774fa37f6d7dd4039d0787f8bed98e`.
- Included unchanged: upstream `include/`, `license.txt` and `readme.md`.

Header-only dependency of Discord RPC v3.4.0. Tests, examples, build scripts and
`bin/jsonchecker/` are omitted. See `license.txt` for upstream license details;
`thirdpartylegalnotices-discord-rpc.txt` in the repository root contains the
notices for the runtime components used by this build.
